title: Strict comparison holds in the uniform Roe algebra of a discrete amenable group
summary: Let $Γ$ be a countable discrete amenable group, and let $A=l^\infty(Γ) \rtimes Γ$. It is shown that if $a, b \in A \otimes \mathcal K$ are positive elements such that $$\mathrm{d}_τ(a) < \mathrm{d}_τ(b),\quad τ\in \mathrm{T}(A),$$ then $a$ is Cuntz subequivalent to $b$. Moreover, consider the universal minimal set $(M, Γ)$.
